title: [P2][a11y,polish] ARIA semantics on progress bars
goal: Progress bar components in app/(app)/insights/progress-bar.tsx and app/(app)/settings/progress-bar.tsx are plain divs with a width percentage; no role='progressbar', no aria-valuenow/min/max. The numeric values are available as adjacent text so this isn't a hard WCAG blocker, but a screen-reader user gets no signal from the bar itself.
in_scope: Add role='progressbar' with aria-valuenow/aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax to both progress-bar components.
out_of_scope: Any visual restyling of the progress bars -- ARIA attributes only.

Consolidating the two separate progress-bar components into one shared component -- not requested by this finding; each gets the same fix independently unless a shared-component refactor is separately decided.
acceptance: Both progress-bar components carry role='progressbar' with correct aria-valuenow/min/max, giving screen-reader users a signal from the bar itself in addition to the existing adjacent numeric text.
invariants: aria-valuenow must stay in sync with the bar's actual rendered percentage -- verify both are driven from the same underlying value, not two independently-computed numbers that could drift.
